title: Persistent serverless foundation — architecture audit and infrastructure design (Neon/R2/Upstash/worker model)
objective: Audit the deployed serverless state problem and design the correct persistent foundation within frozen Architecture v1.1: stateless Vercel application functions over authoritative Neon PostgreSQL + Cloudflare R2 with non-authoritative Upstash Redis coordination, plus a persistent CAD/BIM worker model and a dependency-ordered migration roadmap — documentation-only deliverables, zero code and zero protected-path changes.
acceptance_criteria: The audit covers the governance/spec authority set and application surfaces required by the work item.
The command flows NEW/LINE/UNDO/REDO/SELECTALL/SAVE/OPEN and document session lifecycle are traced end-to-end and every step's state placement is classified.
The production deployment's actual configuration is established from repository evidence, with no assumed infrastructure.

The state inventory classifies every identified state into authoritative persistent, persistent artifacts, ephemeral coordination, presentation client and worker state with target store and migration owner; a machine-readable JSON companion is produced.
The persistence model defines the Neon schema, R2 content-addressed namespace, Redis key inventory and transaction boundaries with concurrency and typed conflict behavior.
The worker model defines durable claim-based job lifecycle and reuses existing engine worker protocol and revision-binding contract.
The multi-instance divergence is specified as a falsifiable proof test with CI shape and deployed equivalent.
The roadmap decomposes implementation into dependency-ordered work items INFRA-002..INFRA-007 and records COMPAT-CAD-011 coordination.
The design stays within frozen Architecture v1.1 and preserves Construction Graph authority, engine/adapter boundaries, versioned authority, epistemic honesty and secret isolation.
No credentials, tokens or environment secret values appear in repository artifacts.
non_goals: No implementation code changes — documentation-only diff.
No modification of frozen architecture-controlled artifacts or protected paths.
No store provisioning, Vercel environment wiring or production deployment changes.
No interference with parallel CAD implementation work.
No successor governance records are created here.
risk_assumptions: The serverless state problem is a state-placement defect, not a platform defect.
Production currently runs with no external secrets, so durable persistence remains production-unwired until its dedicated wiring work.
P016Persist is the persistence precedent to extend.
Neon PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2 and Upstash Redis satisfy the authority split while wiring remains a later step.
The worker platform recommendation is revisable on evidence.
COMPAT-CAD-011 is the CAD-side consumer of this foundation and sequencing INFRA-002..004 ahead of it avoids double-building document persistence.
evidence_requirements: Audit traceability with auditable repository locations.
Disclosure of the pre-existing main governance defect without fixing it inside this work item.
Governance validation of this branch's own docs-only diff.
No test/regression claims beyond the documentation-only change.
